founder.title: Design with depth, not just decoration
founder.description: Architect La Thien Phi, founder of AA Design, brings nearly two decades of architecture and interior design experience into residential, office and commercial projects.
founder.quote: Every project needs its own balance: the owner's way of living, the function of the space and the discipline to build it properly.

items.answer: A simple concept can move faster, while villas and full-service projects need more time for layout, 3D, material and technical coordination. AA Design will estimate timing after reviewing the scope.

story.title: Design is more than arranging interiors
story.lead: Every project has its own story, and design is the art of shaping ideal spaces for living and working.
paragraphs: With nearly 20 years of experience in architecture and interior design, we have had the opportunity to work on a wide range of projects, from apartments and villas to offices and commercial spaces.
I believe a good space should look beautiful, be easy to use, and be resolved well enough to be built exactly as drawn.
